headline: Nevish Line Flares as Passage and Berm Hold Hot
war_summary: Since the morning edition the centre of action has shifted to the Nevish Line, which reports thirteen changes in two hours and thirty-nine on the day to stand four Warden and four Colonial about Grief Mother, Blackcoat Way and Princefal at the hour of filing, with twenty-four-hour losses near sixty-three hundred Colonial and sixty-six hundred Warden and both hourly rates accelerating sharply. Callahan's Passage remains heavy with six changes in two hours and twenty-nine on the day, now eight Warden to two Colonial about Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage, last heard at 11:35. Palantine Berm has quickened to five changes in two hours and thirty-six on the day, now seven Warden-held about Leiri Hermanni and The Pippeli Stones. The Weathered Expanse counts three changes in two hours and twenty-seven on the day at one Warden to eight Colonial, while Stlican Shelf has cooled to one in two hours with twenty-two on the day at two to seven. Stonecradle shows fresh movement at filing with one post unheld. Mooring County and Kuura Strand record no movement in six hours.
